players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Hit a solo HR in the Mariners' 3-2 series-clinching win over St. Louis. Raleigh has been on a home run tear recently with multiple HR in the past week.

sources.title: Mariners sweep Cardinals 3-2, Raleigh HR key

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Delivered a tiebreaking single in the 10th inning with 4 total RBIs as the Phillies ended their 10-game losing streak with an 8-5 win over Atlanta. Wheeler made his 2026 debut in the same game.

sources.title: Harper leads Phillies past Braves 8-5 in 10 innings

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Contributed a fielder's choice RBI in the Giants' 6-3 win over Miami. Landen Roupp was brilliant with 7.2 IP and only 2 hits allowed. Giants have won three consecutive series.

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Made his first start at shortstop this season with Lindor on the IL, going 1-for-5 with 2 walks across the doubleheader as the Mets were swept by Colorado. Mets now 14 losses in their last 16 games.

sources.title: Rockies stifle Mets to clinch series in doubleheader opener

players.name: Francisco Lindor
players.summary: On 10-day IL with a left calf strain. In a walking boot and won't be re-evaluated for 3 weeks. Expected to miss 6-8 weeks total; Ronny Mauricio being recalled from Triple-A to fill in.

sources.title: Lindor in walking boot, could miss until June

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: Went 1-for-3 with a walk and 2 strikeouts as the Cubs were blanked 6-0 by the Dodgers. Was heavily booed at Dodger Stadium after his pre-series comments about LA fans.

sources.title: PCA has worst day at Dodger Stadium

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Had 2 hits in Padres' 12-7 loss to Arizona in Game 2 of the Mexico City Series. The D-backs overcame a 6-run deficit with a massive rally. Merrill's foul tip inadvertently injured the opposing catcher.

sources.title: D-backs stage massive rally in Mexico City Series

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Starred in the Dodgers' 6-0 shutout of the Cubs with 2-for-3, 2 R, 2 RBI including a two-RBI single in the decisive 6-run 4th inning. Justin Wrobleski went 6 scoreless to improve to 4-0.

sources.title: Cubs vs Dodgers April 26 box score

players.name: Giancarlo Stanton
players.summary: Missed his second straight game with right calf tightness suffered Friday vs Houston. IL decision expected Monday. Yankees extended their winning streak to 8 games without him.

sources.title: Stanton out of lineup for 2nd straight day

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Made a brief 1-inning appearance in the Mets' doubleheader loss to the Rockies. No save opportunities. The Mets have not discussed moving Williams from the closer's role despite his 9.95 ERA.

sources.title: Mets haven't discussed moving Williams to setup role

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Made his 2026 season debut going 5 IP, 6 K, 2 ER (ND) as the Phillies rallied for an 8-5 extra-inning win over Atlanta. Wheeler generated 15 whiffs and showed flashes of dominance despite 3 walks.

sources.title: Phillies snap losing streak with Wheeler and Harper

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Dominant first win of 2026: 6 IP, 11 K, 0 BB, 1 ER in the Royals' 12-1 blowout of the Angels. Ragans entered 0-5 before this commanding performance; ERA drops to 4.36.

sources.title: Ragans strikes out 11 as Royals blow out Angels
Cole Ragans first win of 2026 on MLB.com

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Did not pitch April 26; Reds hosted Detroit with a different starter. Burns remains one of the NL's more impressive young arms with a 1.62 ERA through 3 starts in 2026.

sources.title: Chase Burns emerging as dominant Reds pitcher in 2026

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Best start of his 2026 season: 7 shutout IP, 7 K, 2 BB (W) against Oakland. A major bounce-back after a rough early stretch. ERA improves from 5.79 to 4.70.

sources.title: Nathan Eovaldi fires seven scoreless innings for Rangers

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Did not start April 26; Justin Wrobleski started instead in the Dodgers' 6-0 win over Chicago. Sheehan is working through early-season mechanical issues but is healthy; next start expected later this week.

sources.title: Sheehan confident he's close to fixing mechanics

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Struggled in the Angels' 12-1 blowout loss at Kansas City — 5.1 IP, 5 H, 3 ER, 4 K, 2 BB (L) while Ragans was dominant on the other side. ERA rises from 3.89 to 4.05.

sources.title: Angels vs Royals April 26 box score

injuries.name: Francisco Lindor
injuries.note: In walking boot; will not be re-evaluated for 3 weeks. Expected out until early June; worst-case 6-8 weeks. Ronny Mauricio recalled from Triple-A.

source.title: Lindor in walking boot, could miss until June

injuries.name: Giancarlo Stanton
injuries.note: Missed 2nd straight game April 26. IL decision expected Monday April 27. Felt tightness jogging bases in 6th inning Friday vs Astros.

source.title: Stanton out of lineup 2nd straight day, IL decision pending
